Autonomous Delivery Robots for Real-World

From hospitals and enterprise campuses to city sidewalks, Ottonomy’s autonomous delivery robots handle jobs people can’t or shouldn’t do, bridging workforce gaps and driving operational efficiency for demanding environments.

Trusted By

Industries We Serve

Solving workforce challenges and operational bottlenecks with intelligent robots designed for real-world complexity.

Empowering caregivers to focus on what matters most, patient care

Free up 40% of nursing time currently spent on non-clinical tasks by automating essential deliveries throughout hospitals, labs, and pharmacies. Our robots handle medical supplies, laboratory samples, medications, and linens with secure, contactless precision, reducing contamination risks while ensuring critical materials reach their destination on time, every time.

Learn More

Streamlining logistics across sprawling facilities and complex environments

Navigate massive campuses spanning hundreds of acres with autonomous precision. From manufacturing plants to research facilities, our robots eliminate the inefficiencies of human-powered transport across long distances, multiple buildings, and challenging outdoor conditions, delivering everything from parts and tools to documents and meals.

Learn More

Revolutionizing last-mile logistics with autonomous efficiency

Transform the most expensive segment of delivery, the last mile, which represents over 50% of total shipping costs, with autonomous robots that operate around the clock. Perfect for urban deliveries, campus distributions, and high-density residential areas where traditional delivery faces parking, traffic, and accessibility challenges.

Learn More

Capabilities

With contextual AI, modular design, and advanced autonomy, our solutions adapt intelligently to any environment, optimizing operations from logistics to brand activations – indoors or outdoors.

L4 Autonomy Meets Contextual Intelligence

Powered by Contextual AI and L4 autonomy , Ottobots see, understand, and adapt to every environment in real time. Their seamless indoor-outdoor navigation ensures operations run safely and efficiently under any conditions. Advanced perception and intelligent decision-making handle complex pathways, optimize fleet movement, and maintain operational consistency. Every feature is designed to deliver reliable, uninterrupted autonomous operations, from tight indoor corridors to all-weather outdoor environments.

Introducing Ottumn.AI

Ottumn.AI is Ottonomy’s cloud-based orchestration platform designed to unify modular robots and smart infrastructure into a single intelligent system.

Built on neurosymbolic AI and edge-to-cloud architecture, Ottumn.AI extends Ottonomy’s autonomy capabilities across healthcare, industrial, and urban environments.

Explore Ottumn.AI

Ottonomy® robots are transforming healthcare, e-commerce, pharma, and enterprise campuses with seamless, autonomous deliveries for intralogistics and last mile needs. Our fully autonomous robots safely deliver medicines, lab samples, retail packages, and critical materials—curbside, across campuses, and even within facilities—maximizing efficiency and reliability.
